intro.fr: Crystal Project se joue en multiworld avec MultiworldGG.
intro.en: Crystal Project can be played in a multiworld with MultiworldGG.

text.fr: Andrew Willman sort Crystal Project en 2022.
text.en: Andrew Willman releases Crystal Project in 2022.

text.fr: Le monde Crystal Project (Dragons but also Rabbits, FabulaFey, Emerassi) est ajouté à MultiworldGG le 6 août 2025.
text.en: The Crystal Project world (Dragons but also Rabbits, FabulaFey, Emerassi) is added to MultiworldGG on August 6, 2025.
